stemMd: What is the minimum of $|x-2|+|x-7|$ over real $x$?
explanationMd: The expression is the sum of distances from 2 and 7. Any point between those endpoints has total distance 5; outside, the total grows. The triangle inequality confirms the lower bound.

distractorRationale.d: Adds endpoint values rather than their separation.
distractorRationale.b: Reports half the distance between the endpoints.
